participation.context: Paid the twopence, named Egeon, and left the writing till after supper.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Boiled the Monday receipt and entered the twopence.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Kept the pen out of the hot ink and left Gib where he was.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: the Monday horn, twopence, and no writing before supper
relations.quote: After supper you may have the browner ink, and not before.

story.body: You paid for the horn, ate, and did not open the lovers' book. The ink was left to cool until night.
